pages.title: A Deliberate Strain
pages.text: Requires its own Skill Tree unlock first - the recipe stays visible even before then, but crafting it early produces nothing. Place the Overload Core directly against a Living Chest, the same rule that governs a Living Terminal.

pages.title: The Catalyst
pages.text: A Warped Catalyst bridges both of the mod's endgame currencies - Arcane Ink and a Token of the Hunger, alongside a handful of Warped Fungus. You can't craft one without having already earned the Hunger's attention.

pages.title: Pushing Past the Limit
pages.text: Right-click the Core with a Catalyst in hand while the network it's touching sits at its full storage capacity. If it isn't full yet, nothing happens - the Core will tell you how close you are. Once the ritual starts, it runs to completion even if the network drops below capacity partway through - there's no taking it back.

pages.title: What Opens
pages.text: A short, escalating charge-up ends with a small rift tearing open where the Core stood, and a matching one somewhere in a place that has no other doors in. Step through either side to cross; step through again to come back. Any number of separate rituals can be run - each one opens its own private pair into the same shared place beyond.
